day_shape: 75 items dominated by Khamenei week-long funeral coverage across Qom/Najaf/Mashhad, reported Iranian missile fire at two ships in the Strait of Hormuz, Trump 'finish the job' threat rebuffed by FM Araghchi, IDF strikes in south Lebanon and northern Gaza, and Macron's Damascus visit.

threads.label: Khamenei funeral procession week
threads.summary: Iranian state channels and Khamenei's office posted continuous coverage of the slain Supreme Leader's multi-city funeral, with IRIB claiming millions in Qom and 270 foreign journalists accredited in Mashhad. Iran International and Jerusalem Post reported chaotic planning, revenge rhetoric targeting Trump, and Kataib Hezbollah delegations parading in Tehran.

threads.label: Post-Khamenei succession and diaspora reaction
threads.summary: Iran International reported Gholamhossein Mohseni Ejei's reappointment as judiciary chief for a further five-year term under Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei, and examined the redefinition of the Supreme Leader role. Anti-regime diaspora protests took place outside US embassies against a reported US-Iran Memorandum of Understanding.

threads.label: US-Iran diplomacy and Hormuz incident
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Iran fired at least two missiles at commercial ships transiting the Strait of Hormuz, damaging both without casualties per a US official, while FM Araghchi rejected talks after Trump's 'make a deal, or we're going to finish the job' threat. A separate item covered Israeli start-ups working on GPS-jamming countermeasures in the strait.

threads.label: IDF operations in south Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF confirmed a drone strike in Nabatieh al-Fawqa killing four in a vehicle it said approached the buffer zone, and reported over 150 weapons found in Hadatha village over the past month. Northern Command officials told Jerusalem Post there is no set deadline to evacuate points along the Yellow Line.

threads.label: Gaza strikes and Hamas governance move
threads.summary: The IDF said a weekend strike in northern Gaza west of the Yellow Line killed Nukhba operative Hudhayfah al-Hawajri and four others restoring a tunnel, and separately eliminated Hamas training commander Fadi Daghmash. Hamas announced the resignation of its Emergency Committee head and its dissolution, drawing responses from the Board of Peace and Palestinian analysts.

threads.label: British hunger strikers in Evin
threads.summary: Iran International and Jerusalem Post reported UK nationals Craig and Lindsay Foreman are continuing a hunger strike in Tehran's Evin prison. HRANA said the couple have been denied adequate medical care, essential medicine and family phone calls.

threads.label: Macron in Damascus and regional axis moves
threads.summary: French President Macron landed in Syria for a working dinner with President Sharaa; IRIB subsequently reported a car explosion near his hotel in Damascus. Jerusalem Post separately reported an Iranian envoy appearing in Sana'a after being named 'military governor' of the city, and an Iran-linked hacking group targeting Israeli government IT.

events.title_en: Egyptian politician: Iran's people sent a strong message to the enemy in the funeral procession of the martyred leader
events.summary_en: Egyptian politician: Iran's people sent a strong message to the enemy in the funeral procession of the martyred leader. Jamal Zahran, a prominent Egyptian politician, described the magnificent funeral procession of the martyred Imam's body as confirmation of the unity between the Iranian people and their leadership, the strengthening of the legitimacy of the new leadership, and a direct message to America and the Zionist regime. He stressed that the presence of millions of Iranian people demonstrates the cohesion and close trust between the nation and the system of this country and the new leadership, Ayatollah Sayed Mujtaba Khamenei. The presence of the Iranian people was a confirmation of the legitimacy of the system and leadership and conveyed a great message: that the Iranian nation stands behind its leadership and emphasises the necessity of taking vengeance against the enemy.
